baseline.name: Sort prices descending and skip every third
baseline.approach: Use comparison sorting, then pay for the first two candies in each group of three.
baseline.time: O(n log n) with a comparison sort

why: The known 1..100 price domain replaces comparison sorting with counts and descending enumeration.
quantitative_comparison: The archive counts n prices, visits 100 price bins and consumes n counted candies. This replaces comparison-sort growth with n+100 domain work, not a measured runtime percentage.
tradeoffs: Requires the bounded price domain and safe integer totals. For small n or a wide unconstrained domain, sorting may be simpler or faster; guaranteed cache-hit comments are unsupported.
evidence_basis: Static counting-sort-style work model and fixed domain from the source; no benchmark.
